name: evidence_store_summarize
description: Summarize a Tessera Parquet calibration evidence store: count per-run row totals, per-table row breakdowns, and the most-recent ingestion timestamps. Wraps `evidence-store.py summarize`. The summarize subcommand is the read-only companion to the per-source ingest-* subcommands; it gives the L5 orchestrator a one-call health check on the evidence store.

store.description: Path to the evidence store directory (parent of the parquet parts).

run_id.description: If set, restrict the summary to this run id only.

output.description: If set, write the JSON summary to this path (defaults to stdout).
